The gap nobody names

An agent gets you admitted.
Then you’re on your own.

Most services end at the offer letter. But the hardest, most human part of moving abroad begins just after it.

01 / REALITY

The advice is generic.

A checklist can’t tell you which document will actually be questioned, or what a viewing in a new city feels like.

02 / THE DROP-OFF

Support has an expiry date.

Once the visa arrives, the questions keep coming: Anmeldung, SIM cards, insurance, flat hunting. Who answers?

03 / THE COST

Mistakes are expensive.

A missed deadline, a bad housing choice, a confusing appointment—small unknowns can become a very stressful start.

From two girls who went first

We packed our bags for our Master’s—and figured the rest out the hard way.

Why we started ToGermanUni

We didn’t have the help we needed. You shouldn’t have to go without it.

We are two girls who moved to Germany for our Master’s with no consultant and no guidebook—only trial, error and a lot of questions. Now, we turn what we learned into the steady, peer-guided support we wish we had: applications, visa, accommodation and the life beyond.

Our visionA world where no student has to navigate the journey to Germany alone.
Our missionFirst-hand support for Indian students to apply, arrive and truly settle into German university life.
The ToGermanUni way

A clear path, from curious to comfortably settled.

Support that adapts as your questions change—not a one-size-fits-all document list.
